content.title: Why Byrna (BYRN) Stock Is Trading Lower Today
content.summary: Shares of non-lethal weapons company Byrna (NASDAQ:BYRN) fell 4% in the afternoon session after competitor Wrap Technologies (WRAP) announced the launch of its DFR-X drone interdiction system, a new non-lethal response tool for law enforcement. Wrap's new system was designed to transform standard drones from simple observation tools into active intervention devices by using its BolaWrap tether technology. content.summary: Wrap Technologies (WRAP) announced its second research and development counter-unmanned aircraft systems initiative and released a Phase One video showing proof of concept on its website.
